front: The seven functions associated with projects
back: Provide oversight and coordination; solicit and manage feedback; facilitate and support; perform work; apply expertise; provide organizational direction and insight; provide resources.
A designated project manager or similar role leads and guides the work. Typical of predictive projects.
Team members self-organize and self-manage. Typical of agile projects.
Aligning efforts, removing obstacles and keeping the team focused. Performed by project managers or scrum masters.
Encouraging participation and collaboration, building consensus, resolving conflict, supporting people through change.

front: Function: provide organizational direction and insight
back: Prioritizing requirements or scope by value, dependencies and risk. Performed by sponsors, portfolio managers and product owners.
Sponsors and portfolio managers secure funding, people and authority. Functional and resource managers allocate specific people and equipment to the team.
The members of the project team directly involved in project management activities. It may be just the project manager.

front: Does project management depend on the title 'project manager'?
back: No. A functional manager, project lead, product owner or scrum master may perform the function. The nature of the project matters, not the title.

front: Five competencies of a project management team
back: Ways of working, power skills, business acumen, results, social responsibilities.
People skills: emotional intelligence, critical thinking, decision-making, motivation, negotiation, conflict resolution.
Strategic thinking and alignment with the organization: project selection criteria, industry knowledge, business case, financial analysis.
Understanding and applying standards, methods and frameworks: predictive, adaptive or hybrid approaches, brainstorming, change management.
Ways of Working, Power Skills, Business Acumen. Formerly: technical project management, leadership, strategic and business management.
Adapting leadership style to the team's needs, the urgency of the task and the project's complexity, for example directive in a crisis and supportive when the team is autonomous.
Decision leadership beyond the project management team's authority: vision, executive decisions, resources, advocacy, removal of obstacles.
The individuals who perform the project's work and are directly responsible for achieving its objectives.
To gather feedback and verify and validate throughout the life cycle, so the deliverable actually meets their needs and delivers value.
Integrating people, data, processes and business systems to create, develop and maintain a product or service throughout its life cycle.
Introduction, growth, maturity, decline/retirement.
Maintains and prioritizes the product backlog so the team delivers the most valuable features.
Gathers and documents requirements so project scope and product functionality align with business needs.

front: Project management team's duty when using AI tools
back: Ensure data accuracy and unbiased output, monitor the tool's effectiveness, and work with IT to safeguard project information.
